draftContext.markdown: Editorial pipeline: Four daily-logger review drafts are open simultaneously (#421, #433, #449, #450). #421 is four days old. The pipeline has no documented SLA for draft age or escalation path. Whether #433 and #421 are stalled (model passes not running) or queued (running but slow) is not determinable from this window's evidence — this is an honest gap. The three Oct 21 candidate suggestions remain in Needs-review state with zero admissions after a completed pipeline run; the article acknowledges this is consistent with the designed authority gate but cannot confirm whether the admission criteria are calibrated correctly without reviewing candidate content against the rubric. morning-cockpit #60 is technically unblocked; the merge gate is human, owner not identified in available context. lego-village-pipeline #44 and #46 are both marked DO NOT MERGE and have been open since October 11 and 13 respectively — candidates for closure if they have served their analysis purpose. classic-space-venue #4 is load-bearing for the wayfinder cluster and core #567; it has the strongest downstream dependency of any open non-daily-logger PR. capture-agent: act-2026-07-31-adr-61a759 and act-2026-04-07-roadmap-6f4599 are named blockers with no owner, no deadline, and no confirmation of whether the ADRs have been drafted or are still unwritten. The co-pinning mechanism (blob hash + source commit SHA in PR description) should be formalized in an ADR before pipeline behavior is the only documentation of the invariant.
